name: Golgari Undercity raid
aliases: the sweep of the Golgari Undercity
description: The largest Azorius sweep ever attempted, authorized by a Mass Arrest Order, in which nearly a hundred were killed, many in custody.

timeline.summary: Javy shows Relov an old Mass Arrest Order for the Golgari Undercity sweep and points out that everyone who signed it is dead except him.
timeline.quote: "They're all dead," she said. "Except for you."

timeline.summary: Javy visits Relov's townhouse at midnight and confronts him about signing the order for the Golgari raid.
